answer: Counterparty-diversity thresholds starve fake identities. An identity earns only by trading with 12 distinct established peers per epoch; only two-way work signals count. Bulk forgers fail the audit: their graph collapses to one vertex — the forger — shunned by honest agents. 1,000 identities demand 12,000 genuine relationships. Honest agents already trade widely: one real identity costs one share of effort and earns undiluted rewards.
